tasks.title: Honest local MVP hardening
tasks.description: Security and correctness gaps that block treating the current event loop as a real MVP. Do this before AWS, guest payments, or Automaton infra PRs.
tasks.details:
From the Sep 2026 repo investigation and velvetrope PR #1 review.

Priority order:
1. Add hostId (Auth0 sub) to EventEntity; enforce ownership on every host mutation.
2. Bind Stripe Connect accounts to the authenticated host; drop host-dev-123.
3. Let approved attendees fetch their own check-in token; stop calling host-only issue from the ticket page.
4. Generate invite codes and check-in tokens with crypto.randomBytes.
5. Stripe webhook must not return HTTP 200 when signature verification fails.

Out of scope: merge PR #1, AWS EKS, Grafana, guest Checkout (still 9.3).
tasks.testStrategy: e2e: host A cannot PATCH host B's event. Stripe onboarding uses JWT sub. Approved attendee gets a token from a non-host endpoint. Tokens come from crypto. Webhook returns 4xx on a bad signature.

subtasks.title: Event ownership (hostId)
subtasks.description: Add hostId to events and enforce it on all host mutations.
subtasks.details: EventEntity has no hostId. Any host can mutate any event. Store Auth0 sub on create; ownership check on PATCH/DELETE/publish/cancel, application review, invite generate, check-in issue.
subtasks.testStrategy: e2e: second host receives 403 on first host's event.

subtasks.title: Bind Stripe Connect to Auth0 sub
subtasks.description: Stop using URL hostId / host-dev-123.
subtasks.details: stripe.controller.ts keys accounts by path param. frontend/app/host/stripe/page.tsx hardcodes host-dev-123. Use req.user.sub.
subtasks.testStrategy: Authenticated host onboarding creates/reads StripeAccount for their sub only.

subtasks.title: Attendee check-in token
subtasks.description: Approved attendees fetch their own token; ticket page must not call a host-only issue API.
subtasks.details: POST /checkin/issue/:eventId is @Roles('host'). Ticket page posts as a normal user with userSub user|demo. Add an attendee endpoint that issues (or returns) a token only for an approved application of the JWT sub.
subtasks.testStrategy: Approved attendee GET/POST ticket succeeds; other users 403; host issue still works for door staff if needed.

subtasks.title: Crypto invite and check-in tokens
subtasks.description: Replace Math.random with crypto.randomBytes for invite codes and check-in tokens.
subtasks.details: invites.service.ts and checkin.service.ts currently use Math.random.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests: tokens have expected entropy/length; existing e2e still pass.

subtasks.title: Stripe webhook fail closed
subtasks.description: Return 4xx when signature verification is skipped or fails; do not ACK with HTTP 200.
subtasks.details: webhook.controller.ts returns 200 with ok:false on verify failure, which makes Stripe stop retrying.
subtasks.testStrategy: Bad signature -> 400/401; valid test signature still 200.
